scope:
Finite-depth photon energy-transfer proxy on newly saved mixture traces.
No hydrodynamic rerun. Spectrum remains conditional on a grey escape history.
color_temperature_scope: Outer T spectral shape is conditional. Quarter, half and double are sensitivity choices, not confidence limits. Flux-equivalent Teff assumes a blackbody photosphere exactly at the outer radius; it is another conditional spectrum, not independent transport.
limitations: A grey luminosity and total energy alone cannot give a rigorous narrow bound on escaping soft X rays.
mu_en local-retention calculation is a first-interaction deposition model, not full photon/electron Monte Carlo.
Homogeneous depth-profile maximum is a bound only for the chosen heating profile and constant material properties; actual layered conduction/fluorescence can redistribute it.
Pulse angular smearing and Doppler effects omitted; saved radial-ray arrival bins drive soft-tail conduction.
Material k,rho,cp are explicit reference values. Composition and temperature dependent opacity and multiphase response remain to be modeled.
